guideTitle: Best Toaster Ovens for Air Frying (2026)
metaTitle: Best Toaster Ovens for Air Frying
metaDescription: Air fryer toaster oven combos compared on capacity, heating power, footprint and cleanup, so you can crisp wings, bake and toast from one countertop appliance.
expertTake: The Breville BOV900 Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro is the best overall pick because its five independent quartz elements and smart power steering suit both toasting and air frying. The BLACK+DECKER 4-slice is the value pick for singles and couples who want air frying without a large footprint. Anyone short on counter space should skip the combo category entirely and buy a basket air fryer, since these ovens are much larger.
introParagraphs: An air fryer toaster oven puts a fan and a heating system into a box oven, so one appliance can toast, bake, broil and air fry. The tradeoff is size: these ovens are far larger than a basket air fryer and need real counter space.

This guide compares combos built for air frying first. We evaluated each model on published specifications, capacity, door design, heating layout and owner feedback patterns, and we ranked them on how well they crisp food and stay practical day to day.

products.name: Breville BOV900 Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro, Element iQ

specList.label: Functions
specList.value: Roast, bake, dehydrate, air fry and more

products.description:
The Breville BOV900 is built around the Element iQ system, which uses five independent quartz heating elements and software that steers power to where the oven needs it. That design is closer to a real small oven than to an air fryer with a rack, and it covers toasting, baking, roasting and dehydrating as well as air frying.

Against the Cuisinart TOA-55 it offers finer control over heating zones and a more refined build, at a higher price tier. Against the Ninja FO101 it is less about maximum capacity and more about precision. It is the most expensive option here, and it is aimed at cooks who use a countertop oven daily.

Ownership is easier than with cheaper ovens because the interior is designed for cleaning, but crumbs under the elements still need to be shaken out. Clearance is required on all sides when air frying, and the unit takes more counter than a basket fryer. Ovens in this class last longer with gentle cleaning and no abrasive pads on the interior.
products.bestFor: Daily oven users who want precise heat and a premium build in a countertop oven.

products.name: Cuisinart TOA-55 7-in-1 Air Fryer Toaster Oven, 1800 W

specList.label: Load
specList.value: Up to 3 lb of wings or fries, 6 slices of toast

products.description:
The Cuisinart TOA-55 is a 1800 W stainless oven with a 0.6 cubic foot interior. It combines a top-mounted fan with four heating elements to circulate hot air, and the maker lists up to 3 lb of wings or fries and six slices of toast. Seven functions cover the usual toaster oven duties plus air frying.

Against the Breville it is simpler and cheaper, but without the independent element control. Against the Hamilton Beach Easy Reach it uses a conventional drop door, so loading needs clearance in front. Compared with the BLACK+DECKER 4-slice it has noticeably more capacity and power, so it suits a family kitchen.

For ownership, empty the crumb tray often and wipe the interior while warm, since baked-on grease smokes at the next preheat. Use the air fry rack with a tray beneath to catch drips. It draws a lot of power at 1800 W, so avoid running it on a shared circuit with a kettle or microwave.
products.bestFor: Families who want a roomy 0.6 cu ft oven that air fries and toasts reliably.
pros: 1800 W with a top fan gives strong air flow in a roomy cavity
Fits up to 3 lb of wings or fries and six slices of toast
Seven functions cover the standard toaster oven jobs
Stainless body suits a family counter
cons: Drop door needs counter space in front
1800 W draw is heavy for shared circuits

products.name: Ninja Flip SP151 Toaster Oven and Air Fryer, 8-in-1
products.description:
The Ninja Flip is built for the single biggest drawback of this category: size. The oven flips up and away to store against a backsplash, which the maker says frees about half the counter space. It offers eight functions including air fry, roast, bake, pizza, toast, bagel and dehydrate.

Against the Cuisinart TOA-55 it trades conventional placement for a clever storage trick, so it only works if there is a wall behind the oven and space overhead. Against the Ninja FO101 it is smaller and more compact in storage, though it is less roomy when in use. It sells the idea that a counter should not be permanently occupied by an oven.

Ownership is about handling the flip. Let the oven cool fully before flipping, clean the crumb tray before storing upright and keep the cord clear. Hinges and the flip mechanism are the parts to watch in year three, since moving parts wear in ways a fixed oven does not.
products.bestFor: Small kitchens that want an oven that can be stored upright when not in use.

Eight functions include air fry, pizza and dehydrate
Large interior for the stored footprint
Ninja brand has a broad parts and support footprint

products.name: Ninja French Door Premier FO101 Air Fry Oven, 10-in-1, 20.3 Qt

specList.label: Functions
specList.value: 10 including air fry and whole roast

products.description:
The Ninja FO101 is the largest air frying oven in this lineup, with a 20.3 qt cavity, ten functions and 450 F cyclonic air. French doors open together, which makes loading a family-size meal easier than with a drop door. The maker describes the surfaces as PFAS-free, which appeals to buyers who avoid traditional nonstick.

Against the Cuisinart TOA-55 it holds more and runs hotter, but it needs more counter. Against the Breville, it values capacity over refined element control. It makes the most sense for households that want an oven replacement for most weeknight cooking and do not mind giving up counter space.

In daily use, wipe the interior and doors after each cook, empty the crumb tray and clean the air fry basket or tray by hand. French doors need front clearance and rear venting space. Expect longer preheat than a basket fryer, but shorter than a full-size oven.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Easy Reach 6-Slice Air Fryer Toaster Oven

specList.label: Best use
specList.value: Everyday toasting and light air frying

products.description:
The Hamilton Beach Easy Reach is a six-slice combo with a roll-top door that retracts upward as you open it, keeping the door out of the way and your hands away from a hot drop door. It includes a Sure-Crisp air fry function intended to brown foods evenly. It sits in the low-to-mid tier.

Against the Cuisinart TOA-55 it has a lower power profile and fewer cooking modes, but the door is easier to live with in a tight space. Against the BLACK+DECKER 4-slice it offers six slices and a more usable door. It does not match the Breville or Ninja FO101 for capacity or heating control.

Ownership follows the usual oven routine: empty the crumb tray, wipe the interior and avoid abrasive pads. The roll-top mechanism is the part to watch over years of use, since tracks can collect grease. Keep it clear of hanging cabinets so the retracted door has room to move.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 4-Slice Air Fry Toaster Oven, 5-in-1

specList.label: Functions
specList.value: Air fry, bake, broil, toast, keep warm

products.description:
The BLACK+DECKER 4-slice combo is the lowest-cost and most compact oven in this guide. Five functions (air fry, bake, broil, toast and keep warm) cover everyday cooking for one or two people. It is a conventional drop-door design with a smaller interior than the Cuisinart or Ninja ovens.

Against the Cuisinart TOA-55 it cuts capacity and power, which means fewer wings per batch and slower recovery. Against a basket air fryer such as the Ninja AF101, it also toasts and bakes, but takes more counter. The honest value case is a single appliance for a small household that cannot fit both a toaster and an air fryer.

In ownership, clean the crumb tray, wipe splatter promptly and do not overload the rack. Smaller ovens crowd quickly, which hurts air frying results. Treat the interior gently and expect the finish to age sooner than on premium ovens.

buyingCriteria.explanation: These ovens are much bigger than basket air fryers, and they need clearance on all sides for venting. The Ninja Flip stores upright to free counter space, while the Ninja FO101 and Cuisinart TOA-55 need a permanent spot. Measure width, depth and the height under your cabinets, including door swing. A fantastic oven that cannot open fully is a daily annoyance.

Capacity is quoted in slices, cubic feet or quarts. The Cuisinart TOA-55 offers 0.6 cu ft and six slices, the Ninja FO101 offers 20.3 qt, and the BLACK+DECKER offers four slices. A sheet pan that fits matters more than a headline number, so check whether a 9 by 13 inch pan fits. Air frying also needs space around food for airflow.

Air frying quality depends on fan strength and element layout. The Breville uses five independent quartz elements with software, the Cuisinart uses a top fan with four elements, and the Ninja FO101 uses cyclonic air at up to 450 F. More power helps but also draws more current, and an 1800 W oven needs a free outlet. Do not judge by function count alone.

Drop doors need front clearance and can be hot to touch, French doors open together but need width, and roll-top doors like the Hamilton Beach retract upward. Door choice affects daily convenience more than buyers expect. Think about where you will place the oven and how you load trays.

Five to ten functions are common, but air fry, bake, broil and toast cover most use. Dehydrate and whole roast matter only if you will use them. Presets are shortcuts rather than different cooking physics. A clear temperature and time control with a good fan matters more than preset count.

Crumb trays, interior walls and air fry baskets collect grease that smokes at the next preheat. Premium interiors like the Breville clean more easily, while budget models can stain. Moving parts such as the Ninja Flip hinge and the Hamilton Beach roll-top tracks are year-three wear points. Plan a weekly wipe-down and avoid abrasive pads.

howWeEvaluated.title: Air frying capability
howWeEvaluated.description: We started with fan design, wattage and temperature ranges, such as 1800 W on the Cuisinart TOA-55 and 450 F on the Ninja FO101. Heating layout was credited, as with the Breville quartz elements. Specifications were the basis, and our scores are editorial assessments.

howWeEvaluated.title: Footprint and storage
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared sizes and storage tricks, including the Ninja Flip upright design against the larger FO101. Door clearance and venting needs were considered. Ovens that demand permanent counter space were weighed accordingly.

howWeEvaluated.title: Door and loading
howWeEvaluated.description: We considered drop, French and roll-top doors for everyday loading and safety. The Hamilton Beach roll-top and Ninja French doors earned credit for access. Practical use of trays and racks was part of the assessment.

howWeEvaluated.title: Cleaning and longevity
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at interior finish, crumb trays and moving parts. Owner feedback patterns about hinge wear, door tracks and grease buildup shaped the cautions. Premium interiors were favored for easier cleanup.

howWeEvaluated.title: Value and tradeoffs
howWeEvaluated.description: We judged each oven by relative cost tier and did not use price figures. The BLACK+DECKER was judged as a compact value pick, and the Breville was judged on what extra spend actually buys.

maintenance.why: Crumbs and grease burn at the next preheat and smoke. Empty and wipe the tray while cool.
Baked-on splatter is much harder to remove later. Use a damp cloth and mild soap while the oven is warm but not hot.

faq.q: Is an air fryer toaster oven better than a basket air fryer?
faq.a: It is more versatile because it toasts and bakes, but it is larger and slower to preheat. Basket air fryers crisp faster in a smaller footprint. Choose by space and what else you want the oven to do.

faq.q: Do air fryer toaster ovens crisp as well as basket models?
faq.a: They can, but results depend on fan strength and rack position. Good models like the Cuisinart TOA-55 and Ninja FO101 produce solid results, though basket models often crisp in a little less time.
For light use, yes. The BLACK+DECKER and Hamilton Beach cover toasting and light air frying. Expect smaller capacity and less control than premium ovens.

faq.q: How much counter space do I need?
faq.a: More than you expect. Measure the oven plus clearance on all sides and above. The Ninja Flip helps by storing upright, but still needs a wall and head room.

faq.q: Do I need a circuit for 1800 W?
faq.a: A standard kitchen outlet usually handles it, but avoid running a kettle or microwave on the same circuit. Check your breaker and the manual.

faq.q: How long do these ovens last?
faq.a: Many last years with care. Hinges, door tracks and coated surfaces are the common wear points in owner feedback, so clean gently and avoid overloading.
